outcome: Maternal and umbilical arterial metabolic levels
Expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2 related factor 2 (Nrf2) and carbonyl reductase 1 (CBR1) in the placenta
cohort: 100 single-term pregnant women hospitalized for elective cesarean section (50 deficient for 25(OH)D and 50 normal)
finding: Pregnant women with 25(OH)D deficiency had significantly higher triglyceride levels and lower HDL-C levels in both maternal blood and the umbilical artery, and lower placental expression of Nrf2 and CBR1.
